create_VisionTransformerPredictor: create a VisionTransformerPredictor with configurable image size, patch size, embed dimensions, and depth
build_vit_predictor: build a VisionTransformerPredictor via the vit_predictor factory function with default mlp_ratio and norm_layer
run_predictor_forward: run the predictor forward pass with context tokens, mask indices for context and target patches
initialize_weights: initialize predictor weights using trunc_normal_ and rescale attention/MLP weights by layer depth
add_positional_embedding: add 2D or 3D sincos positional embeddings to predictor tokens based on image or video input
